query: How do I get in touch with the Anti-Counterfeit Currency Wing of Tamil Nadu Police?
reference_answer:
Contacting Anti-Counterfeit Currency Wing:
To contact the Anti-Counterfeit Currency Wing in Tamil Nadu Police, you can visit the Tamil Nadu Police website or call the police helpline number (103 or 044-28448000). You can also report cases at your local police station.
answer: To contact the Anti-Counterfeit Currency Wing of Tamil Nadu Police, you can reach out to them through their official email at [email protected] or visit their website for more information. [Document 1]
